topic: How do interference mitigation techniques adapt when handling tunneled versus non-tunneled traffic in multi-beam satellite systems?
consensus_response: Interference mitigation techniques adapt by using rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA) for tunneled traffic and adaptive beamforming for non-tunneled traffic. Beam hopping and hybrid beamforming further optimize resource allocation, minimizing interference hotspots and latency. These techniques balance performance, capacity, and computational complexity.
reference_context: SatCom systems use analog beamforming, RSMA, and ML/AI to mitigate interference, ensuring QoS and efficient resource allocation.
